title: Read the parser exercise harness
description: You can inspect the given helpers and placeholders before implementing the two parsers.

steps.description: tokenize separates commas and minus signs. show formats binary tuples, while parse_atom returns one token and the next position.
parse_list and parse_sub are placeholders. Each currently returns None and preserves the supplied position.
evaluate converts a leaf to float. For a tuple, it recursively evaluates both children and subtracts their values.

steps.question: With the placeholders unchanged, will either call display a constructed tree?
steps.answer: No. Both return None, so both displays say not implemented yet.

steps.description: The supplied output confirms those placeholder messages. The TODO comments leave parser implementation and tree analysis for you.
